summary: Change the domain names of a certificate

parameters.name: certID
parameters.description: ID of the Let's Encrypt certificate, as the list shows it

200.description: The certificate with its new domain names and expiry (the certificate as it was when the list is unchanged)

400.description: Not a Certbot certificate (error.acme-domains-acme-only), a name the challenge does not allow (wildcards need the DNS challenge, IPs need the HTTP challenge), the CA's account needs a value in Settings (error.acme-set-up-request) or cannot be reached (error.acme-unreachable) or was refused (error.acme-refused), or the CA did not issue the certificate (error.acme-domains-failed, with the CA's message)

description:
Issues an ACME (Certbot) certificate again with a new list of domain names, at the certificate's own CA, with its account, challenge and key setting, and reloads nginx. The same list in another order or case changes nothing and runs nothing. If the CA fails, nothing changes. It waits for the ACME server, which can take minutes.

Needs: Certificates manage

requestBody.description: The new list of domain names

domain_names.description: The new domain names: IPs only with the HTTP challenge, wildcards only with the DNS challenge
